Controls & how it works

← → ↑ ↓ / WASD walk (↑↓ change depth) · J / Z punch · K / X kick · L / Space jump · Esc pause · M mute

Punch three times for jab, cross, hook. The second punch staggers a thug; punch again while he reels to grab him, then knee (kick), headbutt (punch) or throw him over your shoulder (jump). A thug behind you eats an elbow. Punch or kick in the air for a jump kick. Punch while standing on a bat, knife, whip, oil drum, crate or dynamite to pick it up; punch again to swing or throw it. Only two enemies swing at once, but the big ones shrug off jabs: bait a swing, sidestep, and punish. Buns heal.

Watch the floor: the freight yard has a conveyor that drags you back and a spike pit to jump, the ridge a rope bridge with a gorge on both sides and boulders rolling down the road, the hideout spike walls and trap floors. The walkable band narrows on the bridge.

Three lives, three continues. Time runs per screen. On a phone use the stick and the three buttons; the ❚❚ button pauses (sound toggle and quit live there).
